question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Arrival
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Arrival"** means the action or process of reaching a destination. (आगमन)

 
 
• **Example: **The **arrival** of the train was eagerly anticipated by the passengers.
 
 
 
• **"Departure"** refers to the action of leaving, typically to start a journey. (प्रस्थान)
 
 
• **Example: **We were sad to see the **departure **of our guests after a lovely weekend.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Arrival'** is **'Departure'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Genesis **(उत्पत्ति): The origin or mode of formation of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The** genesis** of the idea came from a simple conversation.
 
 
 
• **Amass **(संग्रह करना ): Gather together or accumulate a large amount or number of valuable material or things over a period of time.
 
 
• **Example: **She managed to** amass** a fortune by investing wisely.
 
 
 
• **Inception** (आरंभ): The establishment or starting point of an institution or activity.
 
 
• **Example:** The** inception** of the new project was marked by a grand ceremony.
